data.answer:
Yes. The 2023 study found that small and medium enterprises (SMEs) already employing AI staff were more likely to hire additional AI staff than other SMEs, suggesting continued AI specialisation.[1]

However, this is a sample-based finding: existing AI skills were identified using potentially incomplete staff records, limited to around 1,000 per company.[2]

citations.quote: Further, SMEs with existing AI-staff are more likely to hire more AI-staff than other SMEs.
Together this suggests increased AI specialisation by AI-based SMEs

claims.text: The 2023 study found that SMEs with existing AI staff were more likely to hire additional AI staff than other SMEs, suggesting continued AI specialisation.

citations.quote: for each company, the data provides a potentially incomplete sample of staff (limited to ~1000 records) on the basis of which existing AI skills have been identified.

claims.text: The finding is sample-based, with existing AI skills identified from potentially incomplete staff records limited to around 1,000 per company.
